quotes.text: A D321072 review found that `new-reminder` used `bubble` instead of the `CustomEventInit` key `bubbles` and reported no mounted dialog or reminder-row consumer. For that revision, checking only the child event did not establish that Save updated the reminder model and display. The record reports syntax checks but no runtime test, so treat the behavior as a review finding and inspect the current event route before applying it.
